signature.name: Baotu Spring
signature.detail: Jinan's most celebrated spring and the heart of its 'city of springs' reputation, with clear pools and traditional pavilions. Go early in the morning to avoid crowds, and bring a light layer as the shaded gardens can be cool.

signature.name: Daming Lake
signature.detail: A large scenic lake in the center of Jinan, ringed by gardens, temples and willow-lined paths, ideal for a relaxed half-day walk. Late afternoon is the best time for light and cooler temperatures; boats are available on site.

signature.name: Thousand Buddha Mountain
signature.detail: A hillside park with Buddhist carvings, temples and panoramic views over the city. Wear comfortable shoes for the climb and go in the morning or late afternoon to avoid the midday heat.

transport: Metro and buses under $1; taxis inexpensive
